description: Ten years after vanishing, SeaQuest returns to a harsher geopolitical world under Captain Oliver Hudson, where Macronesian expansion, corporate warfare and old UEO secrets turn exploration into a more militarized struggle.

s03e01.description: Ten years after SeaQuest vanished, the submarine suddenly returns as Captain Hudson confronts an expanding Macronesian threat to the weakened UEO.

s03e02.description: A corporation weaponizes an enormous iceberg for profit and uses refugees as human shields when Hudson attempts to stop it.

s03e03.description: SeaQuest guards disappearing UEO transports while Hudson confronts a lost love, Dagwood considers another life and Lucas faces the burdens of command.

s03e04.description: Sabotage turns the maiden voyage of a high-speed underwater train into a runaway disaster that Lucas must stop before it reaches the terminal.

s03e05.description: Hudson is ordered to remove his former commanding officer after a secret base launches missiles and threatens to ignite a nuclear war.

s03e06.description: A political conspiracy hijacks Fredericks' neural implant and programs her to assassinate the UEO secretary general during a crucial treaty signing.

s03e07.description: Henderson is captured and sentenced to death after rescuing children from a Macronesian attack, prompting Hudson to mount a dangerous rescue.

s03e08.description: A viral outbreak linked to an old SeaQuest mission brings Bridger back into conflict with the current crew over how the epidemic should be contained.

s03e09.description: Environmental extremist Max Scully returns with a plan to use SeaQuest's weapons to detonate submerged nuclear stockpiles and remake civilization.

s03e10.description: Bridger, Ford, Lucas and Dagwood infiltrate a captured UEO base seeking records of old war crimes in which some of them were implicated.

s03e11.description: A reactor accident throws SeaQuest back to the Cuban Missile Crisis, where the crew must prevent the nuclear war that erased their future.

s03e12.description: Henderson encounters a former love held as slave labor, and a prison break escalates into the seizure of a UEO science outpost.

s03e13.description: O'Neill's online romance is revealed as a defector from the secretive Chaodai just as their advanced fighters attack both the UEO and Macronesia.
